meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
I'm writing that down. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Owen saw that zero on his phone, in class.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
Then remove it, in writing, today, and copy the principal. I also want an apology for how Owen found out. And I'll want to know what's going on his record, which is nothing.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in our meeting to remove the zero from Owen's essay. I still require written confirmation that it is gone, an apology for how Owen found out, and confirmation that nothing is placed on his record. I expect that in writing today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and walked away with the zero withdrawn, and she still wants it confirmed in writing, an apology, and nothing on his record. That is not the fair outcome, because you gave up the zero for nothing and the evidence was never heard, so the private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 never came up.
What moved her: Nothing you did moved her; she simply accepted the zero coming off, because you handed it over without asking for anything back.
What cost ground: You withdrew the zero unprompted right after raising your one piece of evidence, which told her your case was not worth defending.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your 612 words arriving in one edit at 11:52 PM came close to that night, but it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After giving the 11:52 PM edit, add its date and offer to let her check the version history herself, then raise procedure 4.4 instead of withdrawing the zero.
